rows.grounds: direct object of cooking and offering; rice or grain oblation
absolutive indicating prior action before offering
compound specifying the amount to be offered

items.question: What portion of the cooked oblation must be offered to the deity?
premises: An oblation is prepared by cooking.
Half of that portion is designated.
The designated half goes to the deity.
items.inference: The practitioner should cook the oblation and offer half of it to the deity.
uncertainties: The exact substance of the caru is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having cooked the oblation, one should offer half of it to the deity.
